In Islamic tradition, it is believed that every human being is created in the image of Allah, and possesses an inner light or divine spark. The name Zoyaa could be seen as a reminder of this inherent brightness and the potential for spiritual growth and enlightenment. It may also be a reference to the Hadith of Sahih Bukhari, which states that Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Allah will enter the Gardens of Paradise (the doors) in the company of two: a man with beautiful eyes, and the people will say, 'Which of the two is this?' This Hadith emphasizes the importance of spiritual beauty and inner radiance, and the name Zoyaa could be seen as a reminder of these qualities. Additionally, the name Zoyaa could be a reminder of the significance of Shari'ah law and good deeds, which can help individuals grow closer to God and increase their spiritual radiance and light.
